model.main_precision: standard Q4_0 with Q6_K vocabulary projection

problem_localization.observed_regression: On the long-prompt shuffled routine-box probe, same-GGUF CPU returns the correct D while stock full NPU returns C.
problem_localization.ngl_zero_semantics: GenieX classifies n_gpu_layers=0 as CPU and also sets mtmd_context_params.use_gpu=false.
problem_localization.first_offload_semantics: At n_gpu_layers=1, the pinned llama.cpp offloads the final output layer but no repeating decoder block, while GenieX simultaneously enables accelerator placement for the multimodal projector.
problem_localization.interpretation: The answer changes at the first accelerator-placement boundary. The stock CLI couples output-layer and projector placement, so an instrumented build was required to separate them.

results.placement: CPU output layer, NPU projector and repeating decoder layers
CPU projector, NPU output and repeating decoder layers
CPU projector and output layer, NPU repeating decoder layers

controlled_component_ablation.conclusion: Moving the output layer does not affect the answer. Moving the multimodal projector to CPU restores the correct answer, independently of output-layer placement.

quality_first_panel.placement: CPU multimodal projector; all 28 repeating decoder layers and output layer on NPU

fast_stock_profile.configuration: Unmodified official GenieX v0.3.17 with GGML_HEXAGON_OPFILTER=GELU
fast_stock_profile.interpretation: GELU fallback removes the one answer regression attributable to NPU execution in the r7 same-GGUF control. Because changing operator placement also changes scheduling and intermediate rounding, this localizes the issue to behavior affected by Hexagon GELU placement; it does not by itself prove an isolated GELU kernel defect.

additional_barrier_search.result: All return C for barrier-normal. None recovers the recorded BF16 GPU answer A.
additional_barrier_search.decision: Stop the low-cost search. The CPU-projector placement remains the measured quality leader; disabling Hexagon flash attention is already slower than that profile on the focused box probe and does not fix that probe.

direct_npu_process_evidence.interpretation: Both corrected profiles retain direct Hexagon/CDSP execution evidence. CPU orchestration, media loading, sampling, and the explicitly selected fallback work remain on CPU.

verdict: The original long-prompt NPU regression is not caused by the final output layer. It is controlled by multimodal-projector placement and, more narrowly, by behavior affected when GELU is allowed or disallowed on Hexagon. The quality-first CPU-projector/NPU-decoder profile scores 7/8 and matches all eight recorded BF16 GPU answers on this bounded ordered-frame panel. The unmodified stock GELU-fallback profile scores 6/8, exactly matches same-GGUF CPU answers, and retains most of the stock NPU speed. Neither result proves tensor equivalence, native encoded-video support, broad accuracy, or safety qualification.
